name: Motion (open-source core)

review: Use the actual package manager and pin a reviewed version. Check existing Motion/Framer Motion or another animation runtime first; never add a second runtime automatically.
Use only MIT core features; Motion+ is not required. Check framework/runtime compatibility and license.

evidence: upstream README and metadata reviewed; no independent quality benchmark
verify: Confirm actual installed revision and imports, build, reduced-motion behavior, interrupted transitions and rendered performance.
